lines.en: I crawl among the roots.
My body wriggles.
I push through the wet leaves and show my head.

lines.zh: 我绕着树干盘着往上爬
lines.en: I spiral up around the trunk.
I creep onto a branch.
My antennae reach forward.
I go around a patch of mushrooms.
Each crawl-step comes with a snap of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一节一节往你脚边挪
lines.en: I push segment by segment toward your feet.
A flick of my tail turns me.
I duck behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我钻进一片卷起来的叶子
lines.en: I crawl into a curled-up leaf.
I lie on a leaf.

lines.zh: 我用触角探着前面的空气
lines.en: My antennae test the air ahead.
I am hunting insects.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和树皮差不多。
lines.en: My color matches the bark.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，什么也没咬
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and bite nothing.
The light in the woods is scattered.

lines.zh: 我把头转向有声音的树皮
lines.en: I turn my head toward the rustling bark.

lines.zh: 树皮里有东西在啃木头
lines.en: Something is chewing wood inside the bark.
A bright stripe runs down my back.

lines.zh: 我低下头，嚼着嘴边那点东西
lines.en: I lower my head and chew what's at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我在等一只不小心的小虫。
lines.en: I wait for a careless little bug.
I flatten myself.
I have nothing much to do.
I yawn.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，从下往上看你
lines.en: I raise my head and look up at you.
You are not an insect.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向另一边看你
lines.en: I tip my head the other way to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的手是要伸过来抓我吗
lines.en: Is that hand of yours reaching over to grab me?

lines.zh: 我嘴里的牙比针尖大一点
lines.en: My fangs are barely bigger than needle tips.

lines.zh: 你指头上那点东西在动
lines.en: That bit on your finger is moving.
Can we not fight?

lines.zh: 我往后缩，只留头在外面
lines.en: I shrink back, leaving only my head out.
I open my mouth and close it.
You stand very tall.

lines.zh: 你身上有虫子和汗的味道
lines.en: You smell of insects and sweat.
I blink twice and wait for you.
Are you going to put me in your pocket?
There's no collar on my neck.
Go on and reach for me; I won't dodge.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬人很疼，你别试
lines.en: My bite hurts; don't try it.

lines.zh: 我发出细细的一声尖叫
lines.en: I let out a thin little squeal.

lines.zh: 我把身子团进树根的缝里
lines.en: I bunch myself into a gap between roots.
I'm flipped over, belly to the sky.
A small piece of my back plate splits open.
I burrow into the leaves.
My antennae droop.
I wriggle and can still crawl forward.

lines.zh: 我疼得抬头，还朝你龇牙
lines.en: Hurt, I lift my head and still bare my fangs at you.
I'll remember that scent all my life.
I am not scared yet.
Is that little thing still moving?
The smell is sour; I hesitate.
I crawl closer.
This can be eaten.
Once I bite down, I don't plan to let go.
This insect crunches nicely.
Another one — I'm not full yet.

lines.zh: 你手指缝里还有虫子的味
lines.en: There's still insect smell between your fingers.

lines.zh: 我把嘴边的碎屑舔干净
lines.en: I lick the crumbs from my mouth.
My belly is round now; that's enough.
I settle by your hand.
I'll take this one — thank you.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压住了我的尾巴
lines.en: Your heel pins my tail down.
I curl up, head tucked under my belly.
I crawl aside.
My shell is somewhat hard.

lines.zh: 被撞得翻过来，脚在空里划
lines.en: Knocked onto my back, my legs paddle air.
I right myself.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底贴着我背过去了
lines.en: Your sole came down right against my back.
I crawl onto your boot.
I am fine.
Go on, lift your foot.

lines.zh: 树皮缝里有同类的气味
lines.en: There's the scent of my kind in the bark seams.
They are like me.
We crowd into a hollow.
None of us moves.
The hollow is dark.
I smell my own kind.

lines.zh: 我们一条条爬回各自的叶
lines.en: We crawl back to our own leaves, one by one.
I return to the tree.
The leaves rustle in the wind.
I am alone again.

lines.zh: 我用上颚咬住它的一角
lines.en: I grip one corner of it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 这个比我身子还大一圈
lines.en: This is a full ring bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我咬着它一点点往后拖
lines.en: I drag it backward a little at a time.
It wedges in a crack of bark.
I work it free again.

lines.zh: 我舔了一下，又推到一边
lines.en: I lick it once and shove it aside.
This isn't food; I spit it out.
I push it off the tree.
I'll bury this one under the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 它从我嘴里滑下树去了
lines.en: It slips out of my mouth and down the tree.
I rear my upper body up.
I bare every one of my small fangs.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底抬起来了，我看见了
lines.en: Your boot sole lifts, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面朝你游过去
lines.en: I ripple along the ground toward you.
I can bite.
One step closer and I bite.

lines.zh: 我背上的亮纹绷成一条线
lines.en: The bright stripe on my back pulls taut.
I am going to bite.

lines.zh: 你后退的样子让我更大胆
lines.en: Your backward step makes me bolder.
I crawl faster.
This bite is not light.

lines.zh: 我从落叶下钻出来找你
lines.en: I come out from under the leaf litter for you.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟一动，我就跟上
lines.en: When your heel moves, I follow.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的鞋带往上爬
lines.en: I climb up along your bootlace.
I climb up your leg.
You shake me off.
I crawl back.

lines.zh: 我贴在你靴子后面不动
lines.en: I press still behind your boot.
The trees hide me.

lines.zh: 你走得越快，我跟得越紧
lines.en: The faster you walk, the closer I follow.

lines.zh: 触角先伸进去，探你的脚
lines.en: My antennae reach in first, feeling for your foot.

lines.zh: 我就在你脚边，你没低头
lines.en: I'm right at your feet and you haven't looked down.
You lift your foot.
Now I am on.

lines.zh: 我咬在你手背上，牙扎进去
lines.en: I bite the back of your hand and my fangs sink in.

lines.zh: 我的牙尖得能扎穿树皮
lines.en: My fangs are sharp enough to pierce bark.
I climb onto your arm.

lines.zh: 我又咬第二口，咬在同一处
lines.en: I bite a second time, right on the same spot.
You shake me off.

lines.zh: 我咬完掉下来，翻了个身
lines.en: I bite, drop, and roll over.
I roll upright at once.
Thrown down, I climb right back up.
This bite goes deeper.
You grab me.
I twist and wriggle.
I am not beaten yet.
One more worm in the woods.
I come out of a hollow.

lines.zh: 我停在叶脉分叉的地方
lines.en: I stop where the leaf veins fork.
There are many insects here.

lines.zh: 钻出树皮缝，身上挂着木渣
lines.en: I squeeze out of a bark seam with wood dust on me.
I look up at the big tree.
I open my mouth for the first time.

lines.zh: 我刚露头，又往树皮后躲
lines.en: I poke out, then duck back behind the bark.
I can evolve.
It is still early.

lines.zh: 我从最低的枝开始往上
lines.en: I start climbing from the lowest branch.
The forest is full of chances.

lines.zh: 叶子烧起来，我赶紧往下爬。
lines.en: The leaf catches fire and I scramble down.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔在落叶上。
lines.en: I fall from the tree onto the leaves.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软了，我挣不动。
lines.en: Water soaks me soft and I cannot kick.
The blast blows me off the branch.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在树干上，擦过我。
lines.en: An arrow pins into the trunk beside me.

lines.zh: 咒光扫过，我的触角都麻了
lines.en: Hex-light sweeps over me and my antennae go numb.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没吃到虫了。
lines.en: I have not eaten a bug in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我贴在树皮上。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I cling to the bark.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，也没有叶子。
lines.en: No trees and no leaves in the void.
